series: # --- The carbon price CBAM charges on imported electricity -----------------
# C = EF(exporting country) * ets_price(y)
# cbam_emission_factors.csv. C applies only to flows *into* the EU
# the CBAM scenario - the reference keeps C = 0.
# There is no phase-in for electricity. The CBAM factor tracks the free
# allocation that the corresponding EU production still receives
# electricity generation has had no free allocation since 2013. So the levy is
# 100 % of the ETS price from 1 January 2026
# steel or cement.
# 2024 and 2026 are the observed market. The forward points are the CO2 price
# the TYNDP 2024 scenarios were themselves run with - the same document
# same money year and the same IEA WEO 2022 APS source as the marginal costs
# that give L.
# That is the reason to prefer them to any other projection: taking the carbon
# price out of one scenario and the electricity price out of another would
# price the levy against a market that never existed. ENTSO-E applies one CO2
# price across all three scenarios
year: so C does not vary with the L trajectory.
